name: geo_rag
description: Geospatial RAG — retrieves contextual geographic information from a vector index of OpenStreetMap tags, DEM elevation data, and land-cover statistics for a given area of interest. Returns empty results with an explanatory note if no data has been indexed for the AOI yet — it never fabricates context.

bbox.description: Bounding box [west, south, east, north] in EPSG:4326

query_text.description: Natural language query to semantically search the index

top_k.description: Number of top results to retrieve

context_snippets.description: Retrieved context passages relevant to the query

elevation_stats.description: Min/max/mean elevation for the AOI (if DEM layer queried)

landcover_distribution.description: Land cover class percentages for the AOI (if landcover layer queried)
